notes: BRF S.A. (B3: BRFS3, NYSE: BRFS) — global poultry + pork + processed foods (Sadia, Perdigão, Qualy). Marfrig holds ~50.5% controlling stake (since 2022). Major exporter (Halal/Middle East/Asia). FY ends Dec 31. Pre-2024 EBITDA was depressed by avian-influenza-related restrictions and feed-cost inflation; FY24 marks a strong margin recovery on lower corn/soy and improved Halal pricing.

periods.notes: FY20: Revenue R$39.4bn, EBITDA R$4.6bn (margin 11.7%). Margins pressured by COVID logistics.
FY21: Revenue R$48.3bn (+23%), EBITDA R$4.5bn (margin 9.4%) — feed cost inflation hit margins; net loss R$1.4bn.
FY22: Revenue R$53.7bn (+11%), EBITDA R$4.2bn (margin 7.8%) — record-low operating margins on persistent input costs. Net loss R$3.1bn. R$5bn capital raise.
FY23: Revenue R$53.6bn (flat), EBITDA R$4.8bn (margin 8.9%) — early signs of margin recovery in 2H. Net loss R$1.9bn. Marfrig increased stake; capital structure strengthened post-followon.
FY24: Strong recovery. Revenue R$61.4bn (+15%), EBITDA R$8.2bn (margin 13.4%) — best in 5+ years. Net income R$3.35bn (vs R$1.9bn loss). Leverage 1.2x. Resumed dividends.
